text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-2026-4873 fired for private-control-plane: control-plane-unreachable (customer: AcmeCorp, VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d, region: us-west-2). Pager: maria.g. Links: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-2026-4873

maria.g: acked on PD. Starting triage — first check control-plane health and onprem agent heartbeat.

aj: i'm pulling last seen for agent and control-plane metrics. last heartbeat for onprem-agent-01 was 2026-03-14T03:17:12Z per metric-store.

sam: getting 502s when hitting control plane API from our private control plane lb: `curl -v https://private-control.redwood.internal/health` returns HTTP/1.1 502.

aj: running quick checks: route table shows the peering connection to acme-vpn is up but BGP session flapped around 03:16Z. grabbing traceroute now.

aj: ```
traceroute -n 10.0.4.1
 1  10.0.0.1  1.2 ms
 2  192.0.2.33  12 ms
 3  198.51.100.9  36 ms
```

maria.g: looks like packet loss after the customer's VPN egress. Could be customer-side VPN appliance or their ISP. sam, can you ssh to the control-plane pod and check logs?

sam: on it. `kubectl -n private-control logs deploy/control-plane --since=15m` shows repeated connection timeouts to redis and agent registration failures: `ERROR: agent heartbeat timeout`

keenan: paging in — i saw PD. if agent can't register, control plane will mark nodes degraded. we should try remote restart of onprem agent but coordinate with AcmeCorp SRE first (due to maintenance windows).

maria.g: contacted AcmeCorp via their oncall channel (linked in PD). they're seeing VPN tunnel flaps on their side and a BGP neighbor reset at 03:15Z. they're digging with their network team.

ops-bot: Automated action: creating incident ticket INC-2026-4873 and attaching initial logs. Playbook: private-controlplane-outage-v1 referenced.

aj: quick mitigation options: 1) attempt graceful restart of onprem agent (ssh via bastion), 2) ask customer to stabilize VPN, 3) enable control-plane degraded mode -> stop expecting agent heartbeats (read-only) while customer recovers. which do we want now?

maria.g: option 1 needs customer confirmation. option 3 is fastest to reduce customer impact (control plane will still respond for readonly queries). sam, how bad is customer impact right now?

sam: customer reports failed writes to their private model, inference requests are timing out. Embeddings and non-critical reads still work cached. so user-facing is partial outage for inference write paths.

keenan: i'll take lead. maria, hand off to me in 10. I'm going to try degraded-mode as immediate mitigation and coordinate agent restart with the customer.

maria.g: handing off — keenan you're oncall now, i'm reassigning PD and updating status channel. i'll stay on thread for context. :triangle_flag_on_post:

keenan: ack. Enabling degraded-mode now. ops-bot runbook step: `set-controlplane-mode --customer acmecorp --mode degraded`

ops-bot: Command queued: set-controlplane-mode for acmecorp to degraded. Action by user keegan? (simulated) — mode changed to DEGRADED. Responses now read-only; write queue will buffer.

aj: confirming health endpoints now return 200 for read-only endpoints, but write endpoints 503. adding note to incident.

sam: prepping agent restart steps in case customer gives go-ahead. snippet for onprem agent restart via bastion:```ssh bastion@jump.acmecorp -- ssh admin@onprem-agent-01 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent'```

maria.g: AcmeCorp SRE responded: "we're seeing repeated BGP flaps between our edge and ISP, will escalate to ISP now. we prefer we try the agent restart after they confirm réseaux stable."

keenan: ok, continue monitoring. i'll notify support and customer success to prepare a customer-facing update explaining partial outage and mitigations. sam please capture timestamps and key logs for postmortem.

sam: copied. saving logs and attaching to INC-2026-4873. notable log snippet: `agent registration: timeout waiting for control-plane handshake 03:15:58`

aj: adding firewall / security-group checks: our side saw no config changes. NAT gateway healthy. suggests edge egress instability on customer's side.

maria.g: major action items: (1) degraded-mode applied (2) customer engaged with ISP (3) wait for customer confirmation for agent restart (4) gather PSR and timeline. I'll draft the interim customer update.

keenan: i'll stay on til handoff in 30m. if BGP stabilizes and customer restarts VPN, we'll attempt agent restart and full restore. otherwise we'll schedule a follow-up bridge with customer network team.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-4873 acknowledged by keegan at 2026-03-14T03:22:10Z. Escalation suppressed.

maria.g: quick note for postmortem: consider adding a preconfigured fallback to route agent heartbeats over secondary path (if customer has multiple egress). raising a PR for runbook improvement after this.

keenan: thanks everyone. i'll post a 30m status update in 20m here and update the incident timeline. leaving channel for now but monitoring PD.

maria.g: thx all.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4873 status=investigating, impact=partial, customers_affected=[AcmeCorp], mitigation=degraded-mode, next_update=2026-03-14T03:42:00Z
